summary: Stephanie McLeod, 36, suffered possible broken leg while backcountry skiing with party of three in the Nickelson Creek area; MRA traveled 3.5 miles / 2,400 ft elevation gain to reach her; transported out to Basalt ambulance at Capitol Creek Road, then Aspen Valley Hospital.
location: Nickelson Creek area, off Capitol Creek Road
notes: Source: Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page.
